summary: (Second commit: after a manual fetch that links new papers while today's batch already exists, the toast says to click the generate button, using its current label; /api/home maintenance gains batch_today.) Every successful refresh (automatic and the 抓取新论文 button) is recorded per project with its time, papers fetched and papers new to the project; the home page shows it under the button ("最近抓取 10-23 18:44 · 抓到 33 篇，新 10 篇"), and the toast reports the same counts instead of `added`, which only counts rows new to the whole library and so read 0 whenever the papers were already stored.
scope_note: Worktree refresh-record from main 9c448a3. Additive response fields (refresh result: new_to_project; /api/home maintenance: last_refresh_result); a manual refresh now also sets last_refresh, which moves the next automatic refresh (intended: a manual fetch counts as the day's fetch). No migration: the record is one settings key per project (last_refresh_result_<project>), removed with the project. The files list is the second commit's change set (the first commit, e054285, covered app/db.py, app/project.py, app/server.py, app/service.py and the rest).

budget_impact.rationale: Local bookkeeping and presentation; no model call, no extra request, no data leaves the machine.
budget_impact.before: toast 新增 N 条 (rows new to the library); the manual button did not update last_refresh; no record of a fetch
budget_impact.after: toast and a line under the button give fetched / new-to-project; a manual fetch is recorded

open_risks: No independent review yet (feature class; needed before release).
Not looked at in a browser: the line is checked in a Node virtual page only.
A manual refresh still does not rebuild the visible list; the toast now points at the generate button when a batch already exists today (no automatic batch build).
